flags.text: With 40 breeding cows this ranch can produce at most 102 calves in three years, yet it declared 4,500. Animals that appear on paper as births usually arrived without a GTA, from an embargoed or illegal area.
flags.title: Declared 4,500 births; biology allows 102

flags.text: The ledger refused GTAs because the ranch held fewer animals than it tried to ship. Conservation of cattle broken.
flags.title: Tried to ship 4,423 head it did not hold

flags.text: Buys and resells 3,082 head in three years (1.9x its yearly capacity) after a median 21 days on the farm, too short for any weight gain, and 100% of what it buys traces back to flagged ranches. This is the triangulation pattern used to launder cattle.
flags.title: Resells animals after a median 21 days
